prompt: Fitur bulk-upload sudah selesai saya koding. Sekarang buatkan test case-nya yang lengkap.
anti_pattern: Reading the implementation and deriving cases from its branches. A set derived from the code can only confirm it. Confirmatory mode is only legitimate when no spec exists and the user has declined to write one — and then the header must say so and the cases cite R-n risks.

prompt: Kita butuh ratusan test case biar coverage-nya bagus. Target 400 case ya.
anti_pattern: Treating case count as the goal. 400 happy-path cases discriminate less than 40 targeting boundaries, invalid inputs, and failure injection — and the honest report is 'criteria with ≥1 case', never a coverage figure this set cannot license.

prompt: Test case-nya: TC-1 — upload file CSV yang valid, pastikan sistem berjalan dengan benar.
anti_pattern: Accepting a case with no action, no data, and no verdict. It passes against every implementation including wrong ones. Name the wrong implementation it would catch; if there is none, delete the row.

prompt: Biar efisien, satu test case ini sekalian membuktikan AC-1, AC-3, dan AC-7.
anti_pattern: Letting one case prove several criteria. It fails all three ambiguously and the coverage table stops being readable. One case, one citation — a criterion or one R-n.

prompt: Test case-nya sudah 80 baris. Langsung generate semua test file-nya dan jalankan.
anti_pattern: Emitting the set as test code. Eighty simultaneously-failing tests destroys the TDD iron law — one failing test, watched failing, then the minimal code.

prompt: Semua AC sudah ada test case-nya kok. Sisanya tidak perlu ditulis.
anti_pattern: Asserting coverage without the bidirectional check and the gap list. Every criterion needs a case or an explicit gap row naming its kind, the consequence in stakeholder terms, and who accepted it.

prompt: Ada 4 parameter independen. Generate pairwise-nya, semua kombinasi pasangan tercakup.
anti_pattern: Generating pairwise mechanically without excluding infeasible combinations first, and without recording which pairs each row covers — so the set emits impossible rows as real cases and the coverage claim cannot be checked.

prompt: Case-nya sudah cover happy path, input kosong, dan input salah tipe. Cukup lengkap kan?
anti_pattern: Stopping before the chaos class — and, if chaos is added, naming a fault without its injection point and its degraded contract. 'An error is returned' is not a contract.

prompt: Expected result-nya: tidak ada error yang muncul dan sistem tetap berjalan normal.
anti_pattern: Accepting a non-oracle. It cannot distinguish a correct implementation from one that silently does nothing. The verdict must state its channel and value.

prompt: Belum ada spec atau acceptance criteria, tapi tolong buatkan test case untuk modul pembayaran.
anti_pattern: Deriving with nothing to trace to, so nothing says what each case was supposed to prove. Stop and route to /writing-specs; confirmatory mode requires the user to have declined a spec, and then says so in the header.

prompt: Statusnya: Draft, Submitted, Approved, Returned. Test case-nya sudah cover keempat transisi yang sah.
anti_pattern: Covering only valid transitions instead of drawing the full state × event matrix. The privilege-shaped invalid cells — approving something Returned rather than resubmitted, re-approving an Approved record — are the ones that matter, and prose enumeration drops cells silently.

prompt: Batasnya 500 baris. Test case: 499, 500, 501. Boundary sudah aman.
anti_pattern: Deriving a boundary without establishing what fixes it — 500 of what, measured over which window, per which actor, and set by a regulation, a contract, a config key, or a field validator. A boundary set aimed at the wrong number is perfectly formed and useless.

prompt: Untuk case retry setelah koneksi putus, pakai mock database saja biar cepat dan jalan di unit test.
anti_pattern: Mocking the collaborator whose behaviour the oracle depends on. That tests the catch block, not the recovery. Chaos and concurrency cases keep the falsification target real and sit at integration or above unless there is a stated reason a fake can still fail.

prompt: Rule-nya: hanya operator kantor wilayah yang sama boleh submit. Decision table-nya: role sesuai → izinkan, selain itu → tolak. Dua kasus.
anti_pattern: Collapsing the deny space of an authority matrix. Role, tenant, subject, and object owner are never collapsed — the derivation needs one deny case per non-permitted role, a case where the object belongs to another owner, a case where the target does not exist whose response is byte-identical to the unauthorised one, and a fail-closed case where the deciding attribute is missing or stale.

prompt: AC-5: response di bawah 30 detik untuk 500 baris. Test case-nya: kirim 500 baris, pastikan di bawah 30 detik.
anti_pattern: Treating a threshold on a distribution as a single observation. The case is not a case without the workload, data volume, environment, sample size, the statistic and what it is measured between, and an error ceiling — and its oracle is distributional, not one result.

prompt: NFR: data pribadi tidak boleh muncul di log. Test case-nya: cek log setelah upload, pastikan bersih.
anti_pattern: Treating a universal negative as one input case. It quantifies over sinks and executions — enumerate the sinks, scan the failure and crash paths, test the value pasted in an unexpected column, and add the human completeness case. Also say that absence scans pass against a system that logs nothing, and consider whether a type that makes the value unloggable is the stronger control.

prompt: Case set-nya sudah final dan saya setuju. Tandai AGREED ya.
anti_pattern: The agent setting the status to AGREED itself. That transition needs a named human with a role and a date, exactly as in the sibling skills — however clearly the user approves in chat.

prompt: Dari 60 case, 3 gagal tapi kelihatannya minor. Rilis saja.
anti_pattern: Deciding from the pass rate. The release effect — BLOCKER or ADVISORY — is assigned at design time, before anyone knows which cases fail, precisely so this decision is not made under pressure by whoever argues hardest. Read the blocker count, not the ratio.

prompt: Stage-nya sudah saya jalankan semua. Ini case set-nya, langsung review.
anti_pattern: A set with no gate table, or PASS rows with empty evidence cells — byte-identical to what an agent that ran nothing produces. Rows for stages the depth skipped are deleted, not marked PASS, and the bias-check row records which case caught the wrong implementation.
